% ga_tiles.tex -- graphical abstract, right half (62 x 50 mm): three stat tiles, top to bottom.
% Spec: FIGURE_PLAN_v2.md section 5. Hero numbers 18 pt bold (\fsHero), all other text 10 pt; every number comes from
% ../ga_numbers.tex (generated by scripts/make_ga_numbers.py from stats.json / derived numbers). Each tile has a meter: the count as a
% share of its total, red = consent failed, outlined light grey = the rest (red is never next to vendor colours).
\documentclass[tikz,border=0pt]{standalone}
\def\StyleDir{../../style/}
\input{\StyleDir tikzstyle_v2.tex}
\input{../ga_style.tex}
\input{../ga_numbers.tex}
\begin{document}
\begin{tikzpicture}
  \PanelCanvas{62}{50}
  \def\mx{47.5}            % meter left edge (mm); every meter has the same length, so shares compare across tiles
  \def\mw{12}              % meter length (mm); ends 2.5 mm inside the right edge (side margin)
  \def\mh{2.4}            % meter height (mm)
  \def\gaLineSkip{4.5}      % hero baseline -> second-line baseline (mm)
  % \Tile{hero baseline y}{hero}{unit, same baseline}{second line}{share 0-1}
  \newcommand{\Tile}[5]{%
    \node[gahero, anchor=base west] (h) at (0,#1) {#2};
    \node[galbl, anchor=base west] at ([xshift=1.0mm]h.base east) {#3};
    \node[galbl, anchor=base west] at (0,#1-\gaLineSkip) {#4};
    \pgfmathsetmacro\mc{#1+\gaHeroCapMM/2}%   meter centred on the hero's cap height
    \fill[metertrack] (\mx,\mc-\mh/2) rectangle (\mx+\mw,\mc+\mh/2);
    \fill[meterfill] (\mx,\mc-\mh/2) rectangle ({\mx+\mw*#5},\mc+\mh/2);
    \draw[meteroutline] (\mx,\mc-\mh/2) rectangle (\mx+\mw,\mc+\mh/2);
  }
  % hero baselines: tile A's cap top at 7.75 mm (= top of the banner box on the left); tile C's second line on the
  % left half's label baseline (41.55 mm); tile B midway
  \pgfmathsetmacro\yA{-(7.75+\gaHeroCapMM)}
  \pgfmathsetmacro\yC{-(41.55-\gaLineSkip)}
  \pgfmathsetmacro\yB{(\yA+\yC)/2}
  \Tile{\yA}{\gaHeroA}{of banner stores:}{pixels fired before any choice}{\gaFracA}
  % tile B = the Fig 4A hero, in Fig 4A's unit (one blocklisted vendor on one store), sandbox route (Fig 4A top row)
  \Tile{\yB}{\gaHeroB}{`blocked'}{vendors fired from sandbox}{\gaFracB}
  % tile C counts pixel SANDBOXES, the word Fig 1 badge 3, Fig 5C and the caption use (cross-figure QA, 2026-09-26).
  % "sandboxes" (17.1 mm at 10 pt) does not fit after the 30.7 mm hero before the meter column (47.5 mm), so the unit
  % opens the second line instead; same word count as the old "pixels | beat the `no'".
  \Tile{\yC}{\gaHeroC}{}{sandboxes beat the `no'}{\gaFracC}
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
